body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a critical bug where the CRM calendar view was rendering events with incorrect field mappings, showing "Untitled" events with wrong dates. The root cause was that the console's `ObjectView` component only checked flat view config properties (e.g., `viewDef.startDateField`), but `@objectstack/spec` defines them in a nested format (e.g., `viewDef.calendar.startDateField`).

**Changes:**
- Updated `renderListView` in `ObjectView.tsx` to check nested config format FIRST before falling back to flat config for all 7 view types (kanban, calendar, timeline, map, gallery, gantt, chart)
- Added comprehensive integration test verifying nested calendar config works correctly and prevents "Untitled" fallback issues

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx | Updated all view type configs to check nested format first (e.g., `viewDef.calendar?.startDateField`) before flat fallbacks, ensuring compatibility with @objectstack/spec |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/CalendarNestedConfig.test.tsx | Added integration test using CRM-style nested calendar config, verifying correct field mapping and no "Untitled" events |
